data.narrative:
Deep Atomic is a pre-seed stage nuclear energy company founded by William G.J. Theron. The valuation universe consists of 8 comparable companies across the nuclear energy sector: 3 public entities (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 5 private peers (Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, Zephyr Fusion).

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. The nuclear energy sector contains only 4 same-sector comparables overall, and filtering by stage, timing proximity, or valuation tier yielded fewer than 3 datapoints in any single bracket. A cross-sector median would introduce unacceptable distortion given the specialized capital intensity and regulatory environment of nuclear development. No triangulated valuation range can be defensibly calculated from the available dataset.

Deep Atomic's valuation cannot be determined through the methods applied here. The primary constraint is insufficient granular comparable data at the pre-seed stage within nuclear energy. A credible range would require either: (1) expansion of the peer set to adjacent early-stage deep-tech infrastructure, (2) procurement of transaction multiples from recent nuclear energy financings, or (3) deployment of bottom-up cost-of-capital or DCF approaches using company-specific development timelines and technical assumptions. Without these inputs, any valuation figure would rest on inference rather than observable market data.
